The sum is **8**, but I'm recalling this from the literature rather than deriving it, so treat it as my best recollection.

I believe the result is that every positive integer is the cardinality of some finite partizan misère quotient except 3 and 5. Working out the small cases from first principles would require enumerating misère-equivalence classes of partizan games, which I haven't done here. The sum of the exceptions is 3 + 5 = 8.
